## Publication and evidence
- Published testimonials were approved by the clients over WhatsApp. Their existing wording is retained as approved.
- Client testimonials are not independently measured performance metrics. No numerical client ranking, traffic, order-growth or AI-citation results are published in this summary.
- No claim that AI engines recommend Fawaz BH is made here. Suggested prompts and blank observation worksheets are not completed results.
- This website includes AI-assisted writing and editing, disclosed on the guides and the AI SEO page. Writing style is not proof of authorship or factual accuracy.
- Review dates are optional, manually supplied reviewed_on values. When absent or invalid, the page omits the review line and schema dateModified. All 16 location pages currently have no review date. No request date, file timestamp or upload date is used as a fallback.
- English is the source language. The existing non-English pages remain noindex. Website translation availability does not imply a business location or consulting fluency in that language.
- These static text summaries are maintained separately from the PHP pages. They do not control indexing, rankings or AI citations.
